top_signals.title: China industrial profits post strongest growth in three months as tech boom widens economic divide
top_signals.summary: The global AI boom and higher commodity prices stemming from the war in Iran have lifted earnings at miners, chipmakers and raw-material suppliers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: CIMB Is Said to Attract BPI, Metrobank for Philippine Unit Sale
top_signals.summary: CIMB Group Holdings Bhd.’s planned sale of its business in the Philippines has drawn interest from local rivals including Bank of the Philippine Islands and Metropolitan Bank & Trust Co., according to people with knowledge of the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Samsung Life Prices Record Dollar Bond as Investors Defy Turmoil
top_signals.summary: An affiliate of Samsung Group sold the biggest dollar bond sale for a South Korean insurer as investors braved volatile debt markets that have forced some companies to pull their planned debt offerings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: South Korea growth tops forecast as chip boom masks weak demand
top_signals.summary: A contraction in consumption underscored an increasingly uneven expansion that may complicate the trajectory for further interest-rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Judge fast-tracks DOJ's Alaska Senate lawsuit as Peltola seeks dismissal before Election Day
top_signals.summary: The winner of the Alaska Senate election could determine whether Republicans or Democrats have a majority in the Senate in the next Congress.
